prompt.en: What grew out of the North West Mounted Police?
prompt.fr: Qu'est-ce qui est issu de la Police à cheval du Nord-Ouest?

options.en: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police, Canada's national police force.
options.fr: La Gendarmerie royale du Canada, le corps de police national du pays.

options.en: The provincial police of Ontario and Quebec.
options.fr: Les polices provinciales de l'Ontario et du Québec.

explanation.en: The force established in 1873 became the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, known as the Mounties. It is Canada's national police force and one of the country's best-known symbols.
explanation.fr: Le corps créé en 1873 est devenu la Gendarmerie royale du Canada, dont les membres sont surnommés les « Mounties ». C'est le corps de police national du Canada et l'un des symboles les plus connus du pays.

source.quote: Today, the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP or “the Mounties”) are the national police force and one of Canada’s best-known symbols.

verification.evidence: After the first Métis uprising, Prime Minister Macdonald established the North West Mounted Police (NWMP) in 1873 … Regina became its headquarters. Today, the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP or “the Mounties”) are the national police force and one of Canada’s best-known symbols. … The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) enforce federal laws throughout Canada, and serve as the provincial police in all provinces and territories except Ontario and Quebec, as well as in some municipalities.
